text:
maya: Heads-up — spotted a weird ghost URL on the runtime guide page, intermittently 404ing. page: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#fetch-patterns :eyes:

sam: which exact anchor? I opened the page and it loaded fine for me just now

maya: the anchor `#fetch-patterns` sometimes jumps to top then 404 on the CDN image link next to the example. repro: open page, click the code sample link in the right rail -> sometimes 404 (staging and prod seen)

lorenzo: could be an old shortlink redirect expired. if it's just the image link we can rehost or swap to the canonical docs path. small sed should fix if we know replacement URL

alex: I can patch this — quick plan: replace the shortlink `https://s.redwood.ai/old-kv` with `https://downloads.redwood.ai/assets/kv-fetch-patterns.png` in the mdx, update alt text, and lgtm. will run local staging preview

maya: that sound good. can you also add a tiny note in frontmatter to avoid future shortlink rewrites?

alex: yep. PR incoming. diff snippet: ```diff
- ![kv example](https://s.redwood.ai/old-kv)
+ ![kv example](https://downloads.redwood.ai/assets/kv-fetch-patterns.png)
+ <!-- pinned: avoid shortlink -> use canonical asset host -->
```

sam: pinging docs codeowners: @lorenzo FYI for review, but alex can land after CI passes if it's trivial

docs-bot: Reminder: edits to `runtime/*` will trigger content-review from the docs squad (codeowners). Please include a short description in the PR body.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — small replace + frontmatter comment. I ran `yarn build` locally and preview looks good.

deploy-bot: CI: running docs build (expected ~3m). status: queued -> running.

sam: thanks — if CI is clean i'll approve and we can merge. no audience risk. :shipit:

maya: appreciate it, alex. after merge i'll monitor the page for a couple hours to confirm the 404s stop. :thumbsup:

alex: cool — will watch CI and merge once green (and lorenzo gives quick ok).

lorenzo: quick look now. tiny change, LGTM.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅.

alex: merged and deployed — https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#fetch-patterns — can folks confirm the image loads for them?

maya: confirmed loading from my side, no 404s in last 10m. closing out.

sam: confirmed too. nice quick turnaround.

maya: thanks everyone! keeping this thread for a minute then archiving.
